newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's steel giant to build mill.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's steel giant to build mill.

text.p: Morocco's steel giant Societe Nationale de Siderurgie (SONASID) said on Monday it would build a steel mill estimated at 738 million dirhams ($80 million).
It said in a statement published in newspapers that the decision followed a feasibility study carried out by foreign group W.S. Atkins last year.
SONASID said it would supply 75 percent of the amount but did not say where the rest would be raised. The mill is expected to produce 616,000 tonnes of manufactured iron ore yearly.
Morocco offered 35 percent of the state-owned giant last year in a flotation worth 420 million dirhams. It was oversubscribed with demand totalling 675 million dirhams.
It manufactures concrete steel and wire rod, with average production of 420,000 tonnes satisfying more than 70 percent of domestic demand.
SONASID officials were not immediately available to give further details.
